biography.value: Ocean Lords open with Maelstrom to immediately cluster enemies, then use Abyssal Strike to lock specific targets into Grapples while the vortex handles everything else. Pressurized Stream freezes high-priority targets that manage to stay at range. A Friendly Ocean Lord coordinates complex engagement sequences without repeated instruction — it understands the shape of a fight well enough to anticipate what the summoner needs next. The Ocean Lord wants to pull everything into deep water. Giving it permission to pursue that agenda is simply a matter of telling it which targets matter most.

system.attacksNotes:
Abyssal Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (7 + 7 Str) + 4 cold damage (Half DR); target pushed 15 feet + knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage; Prone + Frosted + Grappled; no save.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage + Prone + Frosted + Grappled + Restrained; ongoing 16 cold damage per round while Grappled.

Pressurized Stream [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 6 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 cold damage (12 + 6 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 18 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frosted + Restrained by pressurized water column for 1 round.
  • Margin 3: 18 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen condition; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Maelstrom (1/encounter) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, creates a 40-foot diameter vortex of pressurized water. All creatures in range make Athletics or Acrobatics [Hard] checks or dragged 20 feet toward the center and knocked Prone. Creatures reaching the center are Grappled and take 9 cold damage per round. Creatures starting their turn in range must check again. Designated allies immune. Lasts 1 minute. Water Mastery: In water, ### Attacks against the Ocean Lord add 1 to both dice. Its Abyssal Strike reach extends to 20 ft while in water. The Ocean Lord is immune to fire damage. Engulf (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Surges over 2 Medium or 1 large creature within 5 feet. Target makes a Reflex save (compare Agil 4 + Melee Combat 5 vs. save successes). Grappled, Restrained, takes 9 cold damage per round. Fortitude [Hard] save each round to break free, or an ally can spend 2 [Interact] actions to pull them clear. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Ocean Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
